**Meitantei Conan: Majutsushi no Chousenjou!** (Detective Conan: The Wizard's Challenge!) is Bandai's 1999 WonderSwan detective adventure, released only in Japan. Conan, Ran, Kogoro, the Detective Boys, Heiji and Kaitou Kid face five cases tied to the "Wizard," a legendary gang of thieves, ending in a treasure hunt at Tropical Land. You investigate around Beika City, collect testimonies in your notebook and solve each mystery with the O-X Tool, a logic grid; a Puzzle mode adds 30 more logic puzzles.

The translation comes in two versions with the same English text: **normal** (upper and lower case) and **ALL CAPS**. Both are made from the same Japanese ROM; pick the one you prefer.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply one of the patches to *Meitantei Conan - Majutsushi no Chousenjou! (Japan).ws* (1 MB, CRC32 92FBF7FB) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. The result is 2 MB; keep the .ws extension.

* Normal: `Meitantei.Conan.Majutsushi.no.Chousenjou.EN.v0.9.bps`, CRC32 CE2C1E0D.
* ALL CAPS: `Meitantei.Conan.Majutsushi.no.Chousenjou.EN.v0.9.ALL.CAPS.bps`, CRC32 39BAF3AD.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply …
